key_rationale: With headline CPI inflation at 4.25% and GVA growth at 7.80%, the current repo rate of 6.50% provides a sufficiently restrictive real interest rate environment. Given that inflation is now well within the target band, maintaining the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance is no longer appropriate; we should shift to a neutral stance to avoid the risks of over-tightening and stifling the ongoing growth recovery.
